description: This file defines the ScreenDao class responsible for database access related to Screen entities, specifically retrieving screen information based on module and action parameters in a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ScreenDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Screen entities, providing methods to retrieve screen data from the database.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves a Screen entity based on the specified module and action, returning null if no matching record is found.
